description: This is a Linux kernel driver source file for the PTM (Packet Transfer Mode) driver related to ADSL, implementing core functions for specific chipsets (Danube, Amazon-SE, AR9). It includes network device setup, interrupt handling, buffer management, and proc filesystem interfaces.

methods.name: ltq_ptm_probe
methods.description: Initializes the driver, allocates network devices, sets up hardware, and registers IRQs.

methods.name: ltq_ptm_remove
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters devices, and frees IRQs.

methods.name: ptm_setup
methods.description: Configures network device parameters and MAC address.

methods.name: ptm_get_stats
methods.description: Returns network statistics for a device.

methods.name: ptm_open
methods.description: Starts network interface and enables NAPI.

methods.name: ptm_stop
methods.description: Stops network interface and disables NAPI.

methods.name: ptm_poll
methods.description: Polls for received packets.

methods.name: ptm_napi_poll
methods.description: NAPI poll function handling packet processing.

methods.name: ptm_hard_start_xmit
methods.description: Transmits a packet by setting up descriptors and signaling hardware.

methods.name: ptm_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for MIB and configuration.

methods.name: ptm_tx_timeout
methods.description: Handles transmission timeout, stops transmission and wakes queue.

methods.name: adsl_led_flash
methods.description: Stub for LED flashing (empty implementation).

methods.name: alloc_skb_rx
methods.description: Allocates socket buffer for receiving packets.

methods.name: get_skb_rx_pointer
methods.description: Retrieves socket buffer pointer from descriptor.

methods.name: get_tx_desc
methods.description: Gets a free transmit descriptor.

methods.name: mailbox_rx_irq_handler
methods.description: Handles received packet interrupt.

methods.name: mailbox_irq_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for mailbox events.

methods.name: mailbox_signal
methods.description: Signals other hardware components via mailbox.

methods.name: do_ptm_tasklet
methods.description: Tasklet for deferred packet processing.

methods.name: dump_skb
methods.description: Debug function to dump socket buffer contents.

methods.name: skb_swap
methods.description: Swaps MAC addresses in socket buffer for debugging.

methods.name: proc_file_create
methods.description: Creates proc filesystem entries for debugging.

methods.name: proc_file_delete
methods.description: Removes proc filesystem entries.

methods.name: proc_read_version
methods.description: Reads driver version info.

methods.name: proc_read_wanmib
methods.description: Reads WAN MIB statistics.

methods.name: proc_write_wanmib
methods.description: Writes WAN MIB configuration or clears stats.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_version
methods.description: Retrieves firmware version info.

methods.name: check_parameters
methods.description: Validates and adjusts driver parameters.

methods.name: init_priv_data
methods.description: Initializes private data structures and buffers.

methods.name: clear_priv_data
methods.description: Frees allocated buffers and resets data structures.

methods.name: init_tables
methods.description: Initializes hardware configuration tables.
